formal_method: Native CellOracle correlation-derived transition and MS3-only row-wise embedding-shift analysis within the frozen 30-dimensional patient-only Harmony state space.

frozen_geometry.interpretation: MS5- and MS6-directed displacement are strongly aligned within the frozen state space.

interpretation_lock: Virtual suppression of all five frozen MS3-associated regulators reproducibly predicted counterfactual displacement away from the MS3 state and toward the frozen MS5 intermediate-state region across HCC08, HCC09, and HCC10. MS6-directed displacement was less uniform and is retained as secondary geometric context. Together with Step33, these results indicate that attenuation of the MS3 proliferative/mitotic architecture is accompanied by state-space movement toward an intermediate differentiated-state region, without establishing complete restoration of an MS6-like transcriptional identity.
claim_boundary: Counterfactual state-space displacement within the frozen CellOracle/Harmony geometry only. These results do not establish lineage conversion, causal cell-state transition, therapeutic efficacy, or experimentally validated reprogramming.
